stock_movements_type_sign_check.name: stock_movements_type_sign_check
stock_movements_type_sign_check.value: ("stock_movements"."type"::text IN ('RESTOCK', 'SALE_RETURN') AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" > 0) OR ("stock_movements"."type"::text IN ('WRITE_OFF', 'SALE') AND "stock_movements"."quantity_delta" < 0) OR "stock_movements"."type"::text = 'ADJUSTMENT'

tariffs_kind_category_check.name: tariffs_kind_category_check
tariffs_kind_category_check.value: ("tariffs"."kind" = 'HOURLY' AND "tariffs"."guest_category" IS NULL) OR ("tariffs"."kind" = 'PER_ENTRY' AND "tariffs"."guest_category" IS NOT NULL)

visit_items_kind_check.name: visit_items_kind_check
visit_items_kind_check.value: ("visit_items"."kind" = 'PRODUCT' AND "visit_items"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("visit_items"."kind" = 'SERVICE' AND "visit_items"."service_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("visit_items"."kind" = 'ENTRY' AND "visit_items"."guest_category" IS NOT NULL) OR ("visit_items"."kind" = 'ROOM_TIME' AND "visit_items"."minutes" IS NOT NULL AND "visit_items"."minutes" > 0)

visits_private_fields_check.name: visits_private_fields_check
visits_private_fields_check.value: ("visits"."kind" = 'PRIVATE' AND "visits"."ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "visits"."hourly_rate" IS NOT NULL AND "visits"."time_step_minutes" IS NOT NULL) OR ("visits"."kind" = 'PUBLIC' AND "visits"."ends_at" IS NULL)
